title.narrative: Igniting Eswatini's Green Engine: Empowering MSMEs for a Just Energy Transition (00140951)

description.narrative: The Joint Programme for Just Energy Transition in Eswatini is a transformative initiative designed to empower Micro, Small, and Medium Enterprises (MSMEs and Community Service Centres as key drivers in the countrys shift towards a low-carbon economy. By facilitating the adoption of renewable energy and energy-efficient technologies, the program will not only reduce greenhouse gas emissions and improve energy access but also enhance MSME productivity and competitiveness. A central focus on implementing clean cooking solutions in schools and neighbourhood care points will create healthier environments, particularly benefiting women and children. Furthermore, the program’s incorporation of circular economy principles will advance sustainable resource management and minimize environmental impact.The JPs multi-faceted approach, targeting key sectors and vulnerable groups, will accelerate progress towards several SDGs, including SDG 3 (Good Health and Well-being), SDG 4 (Quality Education), SDG 7 (Affordable and Clean Energy), SDG 8 (Decent Work and Economic Growth), SDG 12 (Responsible Consumption and Production), and SDG 13 (Climate Action). By building local capacity, fostering innovation, and mobilizing resources, the program will serve as a catalyst for SDG acceleration, driving transformative change and ensuring a just, inclusive, and equitable energy transition that leaves no one behind.
